name: Corn & Soybeans: High-Carry Backwardation & Next-Quarter Returns
description: Analyzes backwardation vs contango regimes in corn (ZC) and soybeans (ZS) over the last 5 years using carry-to-price ratio (front minus back contract / front price). Filters to high-carry backwardation periods (carry > 5%) and shows the distribution of next-quarter (63-day) price returns during those periods. Uses NoAdjustment for meaningful carry levels. Event markers capture each regime flip.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN & SOYBEANS: BACKWARDATION VS CONTANGO REGIMES
# =============================================================================
# Question: How often is each grain market in backwardation, and does it
#   predict the next quarter's roll yield?
#
# Carry signal: carry-to-price ratio = (front - back) / front
#   Positive = backwardation (front > back, positive roll yield)
#   Negative = contango (front < back, negative roll yield)
#
# NoAdjustment used for carry — preserves true price relationships (D16).
# Forward roll yield = carry-to-price ratio 63 bars ahead (S46: use << not forward_returns).
#
# Assets: ZC (Corn), ZS (Soybeans) — same formula runs independently per asset.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()

cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    i_offset=0
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
raw_carry = cont.carry   # front - back contract price ($)

# --- Carry-to-price ratio (comparable across ZC and ZS) ---
# Guard: only compute when close > 0 and carry is valid (S02)
carry_ratio = where(is_valid(raw_carry) and close > 0, raw_carry / close)

# Smooth with 5-day MA to reduce noise from roll artifacts
carry_ratio_smooth = ma(period=5, type=MAType.sma)(carry_ratio)

# --- Regime classification ---
# Backwardation: carry_ratio > 0 (front > back)
# Contango: carry_ratio <= 0 (front < back)
in_backwardation = is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth) and carry_ratio_smooth > 0

# --- Forward roll yield (next quarter = 63 trading days ahead) ---
# Per S46: use << operator for forward level of a signal, NOT forward_returns
# This is the carry-to-price ratio the market will be at in 63 bars
fwd_carry_63d = carry_ratio_smooth << 63

# --- High-carry backwardation filter (carry > 5%) ---
# Isolates the strongest backwardation signals for return analysis
high_carry_backwardation = is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth) and carry_ratio_smooth > 0.01

# --- Next-quarter PRICE returns (63 trading days ahead) ---
# Per S46: forward_returns on price series is correct; << operator is for signal levels
fwd_price_ret_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# Returns filtered to high-carry backwardation days only
hcb_fwd_ret = where(high_carry_backwardation and is_valid(fwd_price_ret_63d), fwd_price_ret_63d)

# Hit rate flag: 1 when return is positive, 0 when negative (ternary, not where, per S41)
hcb_ret_positive = 1.0 if (is_valid(hcb_fwd_ret) and hcb_fwd_ret > 0) else 0.0
hcb_ret_positive_filtered = where(high_carry_backwardation and is_valid(fwd_price_ret_63d), hcb_ret_positive)

# --- Regime flip detection for event markers ---
# Flip to backwardation: was contango, now backwardation
flip_to_backwardation = crossover(carry_ratio_smooth, 0)
# Flip to contango: was backwardation, now contango
flip_to_contango = crossunder(carry_ratio_smooth, 0)
# Any regime flip
any_flip = flip_to_backwardation or flip_to_contango

# Regime label for event marker badge
regime_label = 'Backwardation' if (is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth) and carry_ratio_smooth > 0) else 'Contango'

# --- Annual backwardation frequency (for bar chart) ---
# 1.0 on backwardation days, 0.0 on contango days (ternary, not where, for hit rate)
backwardation_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth) and carry_ratio_smooth > 0) else 0.0

# Year label for grouping
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(index())

# --- Carry series split by regime for visual shading ---
# Positive carry (backwardation) shown in amber, negative (contango) in blue
carry_backwardation = where(in_backwardation, carry_ratio_smooth)
carry_contango = where(not in_backwardation and is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth), carry_ratio_smooth)

bar_ts = index()

# --- Summary table inputs ---
# Hit rate: when in backwardation today, is carry positive in 63 days?
fwd_positive_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_carry_63d) and fwd_carry_63d > 0) else 0.0

# Filter to backwardation days only (for hit rate and avg carry)
hit_when_backwardation = where(in_backwardation and is_valid(fwd_carry_63d), fwd_positive_flag)
carry_on_backwardation_days = where(in_backwardation, carry_ratio_smooth)

# Filter to contango days only
hit_when_contango = where(not in_backwardation and is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth) and is_valid(fwd_carry_63d), fwd_positive_flag)
carry_on_contango_days = where(not in_backwardation and is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth), carry_ratio_smooth)

# Days count: use backwardation_flag and its inverse for Sum aggregation
contango_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth) and carry_ratio_smooth <= 0) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 0: REFERENCE TABLE — Does backwardation predict next quarter roll yield?
# (Tables before charts per R10)
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Does Carry Regime Predict Next Quarter Roll Yield?',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Hit Rate: Fwd Carry Positive (63d)', 'Avg Carry-to-Price', 'Days in Regime (5Y)'],
        col_headers=['When Backwardation', 'When Contango'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       info='% of backwardation days where carry is still positive 63 trading days later'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       info='% of contango days where carry turns positive within 63 trading days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3,
                       info='Mean carry-to-price ratio on backwardation days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3,
                       info='Mean carry-to-price ratio on contango days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0,
                       info='Total trading days in backwardation over 5 years'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0,
                       info='Total trading days in contango over 5 years')
        ]
    ),
    category='Grain Carry Regimes',
    order=0
)(hit_when_backwardation, hit_when_contango, carry_on_backwardation_days, carry_on_contango_days, backwardation_flag, contango_flag)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: CONTEXT — Carry-to-price ratio time series (two series: regime-split)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Carry-to-Price Ratio: Backwardation (+) vs Contango (-)',
    category='Grain Carry Regimes',
    y_axis_label='Carry / Front Price',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero (Regime Boundary)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Backwardation', color=Color.Amber, area=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Contango', color=Color.Blue, area=True)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=(carry_backwardation, carry_contango))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: EVENT MAP — Regime flip event markers
# =============================================================================
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Carry Regime Flip',
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='New Regime',
                type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge,
                card_color_map={"Success": ["Backwardation"], "Error": ["Contango"]}
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Carry-to-Price',
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=3,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Hero
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Front Price',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                table_is_filter=True,
                table_visible=False
            )
        ]
    )
)(regime_label, carry_ratio_smooth, close, any_flip)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: PUNCHLINE — Distribution of next-quarter returns during high-carry backwardation
# High-carry backwardation = carry-to-price ratio > 5%
# =============================================================================
histogram(
    title='Next-Quarter Returns When Carry > 1% (Backwardation)',
    category='Grain Carry Regimes',
    x_axis_label='63-Day Forward Price Return',
    y_axis_label='Frequency (Days)',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    fill_color=Color.Amber,
    fill_opacity=0.75,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero Return')
    ]),
    order=3
)(hcb_fwd_ret)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: REFERENCE TABLE — High-carry backwardation return stats
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='High-Carry Backwardation (Carry > 1%): Next-Quarter Return Stats',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Hit Rate (Return > 0)', 'Days in High-Carry Backwardation (5Y)'],
        col_headers=['Next-Quarter Price Return', ''],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       info='% of days where carry > 1% and 63-day forward price return is positive'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       info='Mean 63-day forward price return on high-carry backwardation days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0,
                       info='Total trading days where carry-to-price ratio exceeded 1%'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       info='Median 63-day forward price return on high-carry backwardation days')
        ]
    ),
    category='Grain Carry Regimes',
    order=4
)(hcb_ret_positive_filtered, hcb_fwd_ret, high_carry_backwardation, hcb_fwd_ret)
